contexts.text: The penalty of rending. AC 957. AC 958. AC 960. AC 961. AC 1983. SE 515. SE 932. SE 1073. SE 1304. SE 3170. SE 3195. SE 3465. SE 3504. SE 4277.
The penalty of rending as to the thoughts. SE 3179.
That which is torn I brought not to thee () = evil not by his fault... Explained.
The evil which man receives from others without any fault of his, is signified in the Word by what is torn. Illustrated.
That which is torn () = the evil which is from the falsity which is injected by the evil, who are the wild beasts in the forest which tear.
If one who is leading a life of good suffers himself to be persuaded (so as not to do it) he is said to be torn; for torn is predicated of good into which falsity is insinuated. Example(s).
That it is the evil who tear, and this by reasonings from external things... Illustrated.
By tearing, Joseph has been torn in pieces () = dissipated by falsities so as to have no existence whatever. AC 5828.

What is torn to pieces is mentioned in the Word, and by it in the proper sense is signified that which perishes by falsities from evils; but that which perishes by evils is called a carcase. But when torn only is mentioned, both are signified... Illustrated.
The Church is thus disturbed and torn in pieces.
If in tearing it has been torn in pieces () = injury inflicted by falsities from evil without the person's fault.
Flesh rent in the field ye shall not eat () = that the falsified good of faith shall not be conjoined... What is rent = what is destroyed through falsities, thus also what is falsified.
To eat a carcase and that which is torn () = the appropriation of evil and falsity.

When the Word is read, its truths ascend to Heaven, and the falsities with which they are conjoined tend to Hell: hence a rending takes place... I have seen these rendings, and heard the noise from them...
As the idea of God... has been thus torn in pieces...
To the end that what is torn in pieces may be made whole.
It is a species of minute pulling to pieces.
The softening is effected by actual discerptions...
Dissociation is effected by a method of discerption.
He was rent by the renders. SE 3465:end.
With profaners... these must be rent asunder; and, when they are being rent asunder, everything of spiritual life is destroyed.
Occurs. AE 780:7. AE 781:11. (the children torn by the bears).
